settings.title: Settings
settings.description: System defaults from forgehub.config -- not credentials (those live in .env). Saving rewrites that file and applies immediately, no restart needed.

tabs.forgeRouterModelsDescription: Model IDs available to agents. Auto is the recommended primary model; explicit classes are useful when planning already knows the workload.
tabs.gitControlDescription: Fixed system entry System Control's Git Control card always offers.
tabs.backupsDescription: Hermes backups land flat here; each backup-enabled project gets its own subdirectory unless it sets its own location.
tabs.cleanupDescription: "Run Cleanup" invokes the same bounded Athos policy used by the weekly foundation-clear cron.
tabs.aiChatDescription: Response language for the AI chat (Workspace tabs and the Assistant panel). Sent to the agent as a hidden instruction on every message -- it never appears in the conversation.

gitControlDefaultRepo.label: Default repo key
gitControlDefaultRepo.help: What Git Control falls back to when no repo is selected -- must resolve to an entry it can find ("hermes" or a registered project key), or status requests will fail.

trashRoot.label: Trash folder
trashRoot.help: Path passed to the authoritative Athos cleanup script; keep it aligned with the weekly foundation-clear default (/root/trash).

timezone.cardDescription: Timezone used for timestamps ForgeHub itself generates (e.g. backup filenames).
timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: IANA zone name (e.g. America/Sao_Paulo for UTC-3). Validated on save.

messages.saved: Settings saved -- applied immediately, no restart needed.
